annotation.protein_name: Putative uric acid sigma-54-dependent transcriptional regulator UacR
function: Essential for both formate-dependent and formate-independent uric acid degradation. May be directly involved in the transcription of uacF in response to hypoxanthine, xanthine, and uric acid.
